title: OPC Launchpad
subtitle: Stop learning AI. Earn with it.

standfirst: Five months of full time training in agentic AI, then two ways forward: launch your own AI powered One Person Company, or enter the market as a professional AI Operator. Delivered by Kydon Group with Singapore Polytechnic under the SkillsFuture Career Transition Programme.

lead: The OPC Launchpad is the complete journey: five months, full time, eight modules, a cohort, and a graduation showcase. You finish with a business built and running.

The AI Operator Professional Series takes the same operator method and cuts it into six standalone courses of two to five days each. Take one to close a specific gap, or take several in any order. No prerequisites, no cohort, and you choose the pace.
Same method. One is a career change, the other is a capability.

modulesStandfirst: The OPC Launchpad is a single integrated programme delivered by Kydon Group in partnership with Singapore Polytechnic. Modules 2, 3 and 4 are delivered by Singapore Polytechnic's School of Computing to its own accredited syllabus and cover 212 of the 580.5 hours.
certificateAwarded: 8 Certificates of Completion, one per module, issued by Singapore Polytechnic

modules.title: Gear Up: Mindset and Business Foundation
modules.certificate: Gear up! Essential Skills for Career Transformation and Professional Growth
modules.synopsis: The foundation of the operator mindset. Participants develop the thinking patterns of an AI leveraged operator, learning to identify opportunities, automate repetitive work, and use generative AI tools for everyday business productivity. This module is the on ramp to everything that follows.
objectives: Adopt the operator mindset and spot high value opportunities to pursue
Identify and automate the repetitive, low value work in your day
Use generative AI tools to boost everyday business productivity
Build fluency across the core AI tools used throughout the programme

modules.title: Programming for Data Science
modules.certificate: Introduction to Programming for Data Science
modules.synopsis: Participants learn Python from the ground up with a focus on data science applications. Covers the core libraries used in professional data workflows and introduces techniques for handling both structured and unstructured data.
objectives: Write Python from first principles for data science tasks
Manipulate and analyse datasets using NumPy and Pandas
Create clear charts and plots with Matplotlib
Work confidently with both structured and unstructured data

modules.title: Fundamentals of Database Management Systems
modules.synopsis: Participants develop a working understanding of how data is stored, organised and retrieved at scale. Covers relational and non relational database design, data warehousing fundamentals, and the ETL processes that underpin modern data infrastructure.
objectives: Design and query relational and non relational databases
Explain data warehousing fundamentals and when to apply them
Build ETL processes to move and transform data reliably
Integrate data from multiple sources into a single store

modules.title: Data Wrangling for Analysis and Visualisation
modules.certificate: From Chaos to Clarity, Data Wrangling for Analysis and Visualisation
modules.synopsis: Participants learn to take raw, messy data and transform it into clean, analysis ready datasets. Covers Python based cleaning techniques, handling data quality issues, and building effective visualisations using Seaborn.
objectives: Clean and prepare messy, raw data into analysis ready datasets with Python
Diagnose and resolve common data quality issues
Summarise and interpret data using descriptive statistics
Communicate insights through effective visualisations with Seaborn

modules.title: Low-Code Business Solutions
modules.certificate: Building Business Solutions with Low-Code Platforms
modules.synopsis: Participants build the core tool of their own One Person Company using no code and AI assisted development. Covers the full build cycle from environment setup through to deployment, with a focus on scalability and maintainability for a one person operator.
objectives: Build a working business tool using no code and low code platforms
Assemble both the front end and back end of your core tool
Accelerate development with AI assisted building techniques
Deploy your solution with scalability and maintainability in mind

modules.title: Unlocking AI: From Data to Predictions and Beyond
modules.certificate: Unlocking AI, From Data to Predictions and Beyond
modules.synopsis: The engine room. Participants learn to reason with data and make decisions by prompting AI rather than building classical models. Covers the full arc from statistical thinking through prompt engineering, agent design and RAG knowledge base construction, culminating in a working AI brain for the participant's own business.
objectives: Understand how large language models work under the hood
Engineer effective prompts to get reliable, repeatable results
Design AI agents that carry out multi step tasks
Build a RAG knowledge base grounded in your own data
Apply AI ethically and responsibly in a business context

modules.title: Integrating Data and AI with Low-Code Development Platform
modules.certificate: Integrating Data and AI with Low-Code Development Platform
modules.synopsis: Participants assemble the full integrated AI business engine, connecting automation flows, API integrations, generative AI layers and an operating dashboard into a single functioning system. The module culminates in the Without-You Test: can the business run without the founder for 48 hours?
objectives: Automate end to end workflows across your business systems
Integrate third party services through their APIs
Add a generative AI layer that powers intelligent automation
Build an operating dashboard to monitor your business
Pass the Without-You Test: prove your business runs without you for 48 hours

modules.title: Leap Forward: Launch Readiness and Showcase
modules.certificate: Leap Forward! Essential Skills for Career Transformation and Professional Growth
modules.synopsis: The final arc prepares participants to graduate and step into their chosen pathway. Covers launch readiness, brand positioning, go-to-market strategy, AI assisted decision making from live business data, and the persuasive narrative needed for the graduation showcase.
objectives: Prepare your business for launch and sustainable growth
Position your brand and craft a go-to-market strategy
Make data driven decisions with AI support
Pitch with confidence and present at the graduation showcase

faqs.q: Who is the OPC Launchpad for?
faqs.a: Mid career professionals with real domain expertise who want to change how they work, not just add a tool. Participants come from marketing, finance, human resources, operations, healthcare and consulting. Your existing expertise is the asset. The programme teaches you to amplify it with agentic AI.

faqs.q: Do I need a technical background?
faqs.a: No. The programme starts from first principles and is built for professionals rather than developers. Prior programming or data analysis experience is an advantage but is not required. You do need to be comfortable with everyday digital tools such as Microsoft Excel, and you need to be willing to work hands on with software every day.

Kydon Group, in partnership with Singapore Polytechnic, under the SkillsFuture Career Transition Programme. Singapore Polytechnic's School of Computing delivers modules 2, 3 and 4 to its own accredited syllabus, covering 212 of the 580.5 hours. Kydon Group delivers the remaining five modules. Future Edge Institute Private Limited, where you are reading this, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Kydon Holdings Pte. Ltd.

Singapore Polytechnic issues all eight Certificates of Completion, one for each module. They are Singapore Polytechnic certificates. Future Edge Institute does not issue certificates for this programme.

faqs.q: What will I have built by the end?
faqs.a: A working business, not a portfolio of exercises. You build the core tool of your own One Person Company, an AI brain grounded in your own data, an integrated engine connecting automation, APIs and a generative AI layer, and an operating dashboard. Module 7 closes with the Without-You Test: proving the business runs without you for 48 hours.

faqs.q: Is it full time, and can I keep working?
faqs.a: It is full time over five months, combining classroom learning with asynchronous e learning. It is not designed to be taken alongside full time employment. It is built for people making a deliberate transition, which is what the SkillsFuture Career Transition Programme exists to support. Cohort 1 starts on 5 October 2026 and applications close on 30 September 2026. Write to sales@kydongrp.com for the full timetable, including the end date, before making any decision about your current employment.

faqs.q: What does it cost, and am I eligible for a subsidy?
faqs.a: The fee tiers are set out in the fees section on this page. All fees include 9 percent GST and exclude supplementary fees, and subsidy eligibility follows the prevailing SkillsFuture Singapore criteria. The subsidy applies to this programme specifically. Courses in the AI Operator Professional Series and the AI Adoption Series are commercial programmes offered by Future Edge Institute and are not eligible for SkillsFuture Credit or other government subsidies.

faqs.q: Do I need a business idea before I start?
faqs.a: No. Module 1 is where you find and test one, and the early work is deliberately about validating a niche rather than committing to your first instinct. Participants who arrive with an idea work on it directly. Participants who arrive without one leave with a validated idea rather than a borrowed one.

Two routes. On the Founder route you launch and run your own AI powered One Person Company, with Kydon's mentorship and ecosystem available to you. On the AI Specialist route you enter the market as a professional AI Operator, helping businesses build, deploy and run AI systems. You choose during the programme, not before it.

faqs.q: What happens if my business idea does not work out?
faqs.a: Then you graduate with a data and AI skillset that the second route is built for. This is a real outcome and worth being plain about: not every idea survives contact with a market, and the programme is structured so that the skills are yours regardless. Many participants finish as AI Operators working for businesses that need these systems built and run, which is a job market rather than a bet.

faqs.q: What support is there after graduation?
faqs.a: Kydon Group's mentorship and network remain open to graduates. Spaze Ventures, an Accredited Mentor Partner appointed by Enterprise Singapore, supports qualifying graduates through the Startup SG Founder grant process with mentorship, application guidance and incubation support. Grant approval is decided by Enterprise Singapore against its own criteria, not by us.

faqs.q: Does the programme connect me to enterprise clients?
faqs.a: Kydon Group operates an AI Marketplace that matches operators to businesses needing AI work delivered. That is a Kydon Group service and access to it is on Kydon's terms, not a guarantee attached to this programme. Future Edge Institute does not operate it.

faqs.q: What do I need to bring?
faqs.a: Your own laptop, for use throughout the programme. Everything else, including the software environments and the tooling, is covered in the modules. The entry requirements are listed in full on this page.

faqs.q: How is this different from the short courses?
faqs.a: The OPC Launchpad is the complete journey: five months, full time, eight modules, one cohort, and a graduation showcase. You finish with a business built and running. The AI Operator Professional Series takes the same operator method and cuts it into six standalone courses of two to five days, with no prerequisites and no cohort, so you can take one to close a specific gap. Same method. One is a career change, the other is a capability.
